name: definition-year-number-table
description: Invalid definition (fiscalclock 0.3.0). Spec rule, paraphrased: year_number is start, end or majority; any other value, table included, is INVALID_VALUE (UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE in 0.2.0). This vector replaces a 0.2.0 vector whose expected error changed in 0.3.0, as issue #85 explains, definition-unsupported-feature-year-number-table. The definition has no other error, so the complete error list is asserted (code and path of each error, sorted by path, then code).

source.citation: spec/definition-v1.md, year and subdivision type table and Cross-block checks (fiscalclock 0.3.0, ADR-0022), and spec/api-v1.md error catalogue
